subject: Re: Kickoff: BiGG - synthetic sparse graphs for the index teams
body:
Anders,

Staffing and resources:

- Vera 50% (modeling lead through April), Rosa 40% (data prep + stats validation), Chiara 30% (index-team integration glue).
- Jorge Vidal is committed at 70% to bigg for all of May 2026 - he owns the CUDA build and the featured-generation extension work, and the May integration milestone doesn't happen without him. I've flagged this allocation to resourcing as firm.
- Compute: training on our graph scales fits on 8-16 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort; generation is even lighter. No reservation ask.
- The gcc + CUDA toolkit build is the usual pain; Jorge already has it green in a container, which unblocks everyone else.

Risk to watch: the sanitized-statistics approach needs Kofi's sign-off that summary statistics don't constitute production data. Filed this week, 2-3 week SLA means an answer by early April.

Alina
